title: "Sir, mujhe bhi detain kar lo"
situation: A young man asks police to detain him so he can be with two friends already on the detention bus. Police first refuse and tell him to leave; he insists; amused, they take him in through the front door. His two friends slip out of the rear door.

lines.text: Sir, mujhe bhi detain kar lo, mere dost andar hai.
lines.speaker: protester

lines.text: Mujhe bhi unke saath hi le chalo.
lines.speaker: protester

reactionBeats: Officers refuse, he insists, officers are amused and agree; helped in through the front door while friends leave by the rear (Vartha Bharati). NDTV reports he then asked to leave; that line is not quoted in any source read.

paraphrased: Vartha Bharati says social media users were amused but quotes no comments.

buildThis.situation: Ask Sharma to detain you to reach Nikhil; as you climb in the front, Nikhil and Kabir climb out the back, and now you need a reason to be released.
